description: Aimtech Tiger Shark sight mount: also allow attaching a Lobaev Arms 30mm mount (editmount/pushset). Uses 'add' + '/-' to append one entry rather than replacing the whole Filter list - contrast with mag-pmag-gen-m3-556.json's intentional full-array replace. Original deduped via a JS Set; this static append doesn't check whether 57c69dd424597774c03b7bbc is already in the list, so if a future SPT update already allows it, this would add a harmless duplicate entry (no gameplay effect, just a slightly redundant list) rather than an error.
